summary: Fixed a confirmed deploy defect from the prior dispatch: literature-coverage-delta.sh and literature-term-match.sh were created but never registered in agent-system/extensions/literature/manifest.json's provides.scripts array (an explicit 40-entry list, not a glob), so deploy-headless.sh never copied them into .claude/scripts/ and the deployed literature-lit-flag-resolve.sh silently took its fail-open path -- the coverage-delta guard was inert in production despite a fully passing source-store test suite. Registered both scripts in provides.scripts. Also found and fixed a related, same-class metadata drift while auditing: agent-system/extensions/literature/index-entries.json carried stale line_count values for sparse-coverage.md (61 vs actual 133) and adhoc-navigation-directive.md (107 vs actual 111), both touched by the prior dispatch. Checked all other manifest categories (agents/commands/skills/context) the prior dispatch touched; those resolve correctly (context is directory-deployed, not an explicit per-file list, so no registration gap was possible there). Redeployed via deploy-headless.sh (exit 0; the only fast-gate failure -- verify-deploy's doc-lint check -- is pre-existing and traces to unrelated core/typst/project-wide issues from tasks predating this one, confirmed via git log). Verified against the DEPLOYED tree directly, not the source store: .claude/scripts/literature-coverage-delta.sh and .claude/scripts/literature-term-match.sh now exist with correct permissions, and the deployed copy of test-lit-pipeline.sh --runtime (run from .claude/scripts/, exercising the deployed sibling scripts) passes 44/0/0 including all six Section H coverage-delta cases -- confirming the resolver now reaches the guard rather than its fail-open branch. Re-ran the source-store suite too (44/0/0, no regression). Appended a 'Post-Completion Defect and Fix' section to the existing summary recording the defect, the fix, and the generalizable lesson that source-store-only test verification cannot catch a manifest registration gap.

artifacts.summary: Updated with a new 'Post-Completion Defect and Fix' section documenting the manifest registration gap, its fix, and the generalizable source-store-vs-deployed-tree verification lesson.

decisions_made: Registered literature-coverage-delta.sh and literature-term-match.sh in manifest.json's provides.scripts, placed immediately after literature-lit-flag-resolve.sh (the consumer script) to keep the related trio adjacent

Audited all other provides.* categories the prior dispatch touched (context files under project/literature) and confirmed no equivalent gap exists there: provides.context registers directories, not individual files, so a file added under an already-declared directory (project/literature) deploys automatically -- this category cannot suffer the same class of omission as the explicit-list provides.scripts

Fixed two stale index-entries.json line_count values found via check-extension-docs.sh while auditing (Rule R), since they were introduced by edits to files the prior dispatch touched and are the same root-cause class (manifest metadata not kept in sync with an edited file) -- did not attempt to fix two unrelated, pre-existing Rule S failures in corpus-directory-conventions.md and shared-module-extraction-for-gate-checks.md, confirmed via git log to predate this task (tasks 80 and 69 respectively) and out of this defect's scope

Verified strictly against the deployed .claude/scripts/ tree (not the source store) per the explicit instruction: re-ran the deployed copy of test-lit-pipeline.sh --runtime, which passed 44/0/0 including the coverage-delta Section H cases, confirming production reachability rather than re-trusting the source-store result
